notes.title: Update #2 Demo v2 & Current Progress
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746277/7d2a90a838dd7adbf32e15ac5d72718ee1640cdb.png[/img]
Good day everyone!
After 7 months of working and slaving away, we're finally back with a bigger, faster and stronger demo!! 
Here are the updates for the new demo:
- added Mac and Linux version
- added sparkles in the cursor
- added popup chapter title and BGM box
- improved quality of writing
- added hover for shortcut button on the dialogue box
- enabled and improved Save/Load/Option function
- enabled QSave/QLoad/Skip/Auto function
- improvement in GUI of Rythm mini-game
- added motion for artwork displays such as sprite/CG/BG

Also, our current progress is:
Artwork: 95%
Sound: 100%
Script: 100%
Proofread: 70%
Program: 70%

PS: We have a very important news for you! 
Awakening of Celestial will be released in early 2019. We're sorry for the long delay because of some problem we faced in the early production. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746277/c3289e49ee65f0ee79b807100bac7ae161dfd380.png[/img]

But it will worth the wait! So please keep on supporting us and wait for the long-awaited release of Awakening of Celestial!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746277/576922126b4ccc7698078a1ba7710885fa35dc9a.png[/img]
